name: Fire
origin: forged in searing elemental fire, its form tempered in blazing crucibles where heat never dies.

name: Ice
origin: shaped by ancient, bitter frost, its essence hardened in the silence of endless winter.

name: Lightning
origin: born from violent thunderous storms, its body crackling with the fury of sky‑splitting bolts.

traits.name: Static Reflexes
entries: The creature has advantage on Dexterity saving throws made to avoid lightning or thunder effects.

name: Radiant
origin: touched by brilliant celestial light, its spirit infused with the glow of distant heavens.

name: Poison
origin: steeped in venomous swamps and toxic mists, its blood thick with noxious alchemy.

name: Earth
origin: carved from stone and soil deep underground, its frame shaped by the slow patience of the earth.

name: Water
origin: raised from the depths of the oceans, its movements echoing the pull and sway of the tides.

traits.name: Amphibious
entries: The creature can breathe both air and water.

name: Metal
origin: hammered into being by metallic forces, its body ringing with the echo of celestial anvils.

name: Blood
origin: formed from ancient, powerful bloodlines, its essence pulsing with inherited might and memory.

name: Arcane
origin: woven together by raw magical energies, its existence held together by spellcraft alone.

name: Necrotic
origin: animated by deathly, decaying forces, its presence chilling the air with lingering dread.

name: Celestial
origin: born from the distant heavens, its form shimmering with divine purpose and gentle radiance.

name: Infernal
origin: spawned from the fires of the lower realms, its soul marked by smoldering malice and infernal heat.

name: Psychic
origin: shaped by overwhelming psychic pressure, its thoughts echoing with alien whispers and fractured visions.

name: Void
origin: drawn from the emptiness between worlds, its presence bending light and thought around a hollow core.
